speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness. To help me narrow down the cause, how many weeks postpartum are you, and what is your current temperature?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; could you tell me if you have noticed any foul-smelling lochia, chills, or pain when urinating? Additionally, were you able to pass gas since delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Uterine tenderness. I also have Decreased bowel sounds, Increased frequency of urination, Fever.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Puerperal endometritis with possible postpartum urinary retention.
